scripts.dev:ai: if [ -x cortex/.venv/bin/python ]; then cd cortex && set -a && { [ ! -f .env ] || . ./.env; } && set +a && .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn cortex.server:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8890; else echo 'AI service not installed. Run: npm run setup:ai'; tail -f /dev/null; fi
scripts.build: npm --prefix console run build && go build ./...
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run typecheck && npm run test:e2e
